Desperado.desc: +10% Melee Critical Hit Chance & +25% Melee Finesse Bonus.
Desperado.cn: 近战暴击率+10%，近战精巧加成+25%。

Infiltrate.desc: Replenish all Toughness and enter Stealth for 8 s, gaining +25% Movement Speed. Leaving Stealth Suppresses nearby Enemies. While in Stealth, and for 8 s afterwards, you have +30% Damage. Attacking makes you leave Stealth. Base Cooldown: 40 s.
Infiltrate.cn: 恢复全部韧性并进入隐身状态8秒，移动速度+25%。离开隐身时会压制附近敌人。隐身期间及隐身结束后的8秒内，伤害+30%。发动攻击会结束隐身。基础冷却时间40秒。

Agile Engagement.desc: Killing an enemy with a Melee Attack grants +25% Ranged Damage and killing an enemy with a Ranged Attack grants +25% Melee Damage. Lasts 6 s.
Agile Engagement.cn: 近战击杀使远程伤害+25%；远程击杀使近战伤害+25%。持续6秒。

Executioner's Stance.desc: Enter Ranged Stance for 6 s. When in Ranged Stance you instantly equip your ranged weapon, deal +25% Ranged Damage, +25% Ranged Weakspot Damage, replenish 10% Toughness each second, and your Spread and Recoil are greatly reduced. Human-sized Elite Enemies and Specialist Enemies are highlighted for 6 s. Killing a highlighted Enemy refreshes the duration of its bonuses for 6 s. Base Cooldown: 30 s. This is an augmented version of Volley Fire .
Executioner's Stance.cn: 进入远程姿态6秒。处于远程姿态时立即装备远程武器，远程伤害+25%、远程弱点伤害+25%，每秒恢复10%韧性，并大幅降低散布与后坐力。人类型精英和专家敌人会被高亮6秒；击杀被高亮的敌人会将这些加成的持续时间刷新为6秒。基础冷却时间30秒。该技能是“齐射”的强化版本。

Enhanced Target Priority.desc: Executioner's Stance now outlines Elite & Specialist Enemies for Allies in Coherency for 6 s.
Enhanced Target Priority.cn: “处决者姿态”现在会为协同范围内的盟友高亮精英和专家敌人，持续6秒。

Voice of Command.desc: Replenishes your Toughness & Staggers all Enemies within 9 m. Base Cooldown 40 s.
Voice of Command.cn: 恢复你的韧性，并使9米范围内的所有敌人踉跄。基础冷却时间40秒。

Longshot.desc: You deal +10% Ranged Damage to targets within 12.5 m and up to +25% Ranged Damage to targets further away. Maximum bonus at 30 m.
Longshot.cn: 对12.5米内的目标造成+10%远程伤害；距离越远加成越高，最高+25%远程伤害，并在30米时达到最大值。

The Bigger they Are ....desc: Executioner's Stance now outlines all Ogryn, Captain, and Monstrosity Enemies and has its duration increased to 9 s.
The Bigger they Are ....cn: “处决者姿态”现在会高亮所有欧格林、队长和巨兽敌人，并将持续时间延长至9秒。

Chink in their Armour.desc: +15% Rending when at, or over, 10 stacks of Focus.
Chink in their Armour.cn: 拥有10层或更多“专注”时，获得+15%撕裂。

Tunnel Vision.desc: +4% Toughness Replenishment for each stack of Focus. In addition, weakspot kills restore 10% Stamina.
Tunnel Vision.cn: 每层“专注”提供+4%韧性恢复量。此外，弱点击杀恢复10%耐力。

Weapons Specialist.desc: Gain Ranged Specialist on Melee Kills (Stacks 10 times). Gain Melee Specialist on Ranged Kill (Stacks 1 times.) When you wield your Ranged Weapon, you activate your Ranged Specialist effect to gain +2% Ranged Attack Speed, 2% Reload Speed, as well as +33% Ranged Critical Hit Chance on your next shot, per stack. Lasts 10 s. When you wield your Melee Weapon, you activate your Melee Specialist effect, to gain +15% Melee Attack Speed, and 10% Dodge Speed and Dodge Distance. Lasts 10 s.
Weapons Specialist.cn: 近战击杀获得“远程专家”（最多10层）；远程击杀获得“近战专家”（最多1层）。装备远程武器时激活“远程专家”：每层提供+2%远程攻击速度、+2%装填速度，并使下一发射击获得+33%远程暴击率，持续10秒。装备近战武器时激活“近战专家”：获得+15%近战攻击速度、+10%闪避速度和+10%闪避距离，持续10秒。

Focus Target!.desc: Gain Focus Target every 1.5 s (Stacks 4 times). Tagging an Enemy applies the Focus Target stacks to them, causing them to take +5% additional Damage for each stack, and resets your Focus Target stacks to 1.
Focus Target!.cn: 每1.5秒获得1层“锁定目标”，最多4层。标记敌人时会将当前层数施加到该敌人身上，使其每层额外受到5%伤害，并将你的“锁定目标”层数重置为1层。

Enduring Faith.desc: +40% Toughness Damage Reduction on Critical Hit for 4 s.
Enduring Faith.cn: 暴击后获得+40%韧性伤害减免，持续4秒。

Beacon of Purity.desc: Heal 1.5 Corruption from the current Wound for you and Allies in Coherency every 1 s.
Beacon of Purity.cn: 每1秒为你和协同范围内的盟友治疗当前伤口中的1.5点腐化。

Unfaltering.desc: Become Uninterruptible while charging Melee Attacks. Remove +100% of Heavy Melee Attack Movement Speed penalties.
Unfaltering.cn: 蓄力近战攻击时不会被打断，并完全移除重型近战攻击蓄力时的移动速度惩罚。

Quietude.desc: Replenish 4% Toughness for each 10% of Peril Quelled or Generated.
Quietude.cn: 每平息或生成10%危机值，恢复4%韧性。

Kinetic Flayer.desc: All Attacks against Specialists, Elites and Monstrosities, have 100% chance on Hit to Brain Rupture the target. This cannot occur while at critical Peril, and has a Cooldown of 12 s.
Kinetic Flayer.cn: 对专家、精英和巨兽敌人的所有攻击命中时，都有100%几率对目标触发“颅脑崩裂”。处于临界危机值时无法触发，冷却时间12秒。

Kinetic Presence.desc: +10% Damage against Elite Enemies for you and Allies in Coherency.
Kinetic Presence.cn: 你和协同范围内的盟友对精英敌人的伤害+10%。

Warp Siphon.desc: Killing an Elite or Specialist Enemy gains you a Warp Charge for 25 s, stacking 4 time(s). Each Stack increases Base Damage by +4% . Your next Combat Ability spends all available Warp Charges to reduce the Cooldown of that Combat Ability by 7.5% per Warp Charge.
Warp Siphon.cn: 击杀精英或专家敌人获得1层“亚空间充能”，持续25秒，最多4层。每层使基础伤害+4%。下一次使用战斗技能时会消耗全部亚空间充能，每层使该战斗技能的冷却时间缩短7.5%。

Empowered Psionics.desc: Kills have a 10% chance to Empower your next Blitz. Empowered Brain Rupture : 100% Peril Cost Reduction 50% Cast time Reduction +50% Damage Empowered Smite : +200% Damage 50% faster spread between enemies Empowered Assail : 100% Peril Cost Reduction. Base Damage increase from 125 to 150 . Does not consume any charges.
Empowered Psionics.cn: 击杀敌人有10%几率强化你的下一次闪击。“强化颅脑崩裂”：危机值消耗降低100%，施放时间缩短50%，伤害+50%。“强化惩戒”：伤害+200%，在敌人之间的扩散速度提高50%。“强化灵能攻击”：危机值消耗降低100%，基础伤害由125提高至150，且不消耗充能次数。

Inner Tranquility.desc: -8% Peril Generation Reduction for each Warp Charge.
Inner Tranquility.cn: 每层“亚空间充能”使危机值生成降低8%。

Bio-Lodestone.desc: Increases the chance to gain Empowered Psionics on Kill from 10% to 15% .
Bio-Lodestone.cn: 击杀时获得“灵能强化”的几率由10%提高至15%。

Psychic Leeching.desc: Using your Blitz while Empowered Psionics is active replenishes 20% Toughness to you and Allies in Coherency.
Psychic Leeching.cn: “灵能强化”激活期间使用闪击时，为你和协同范围内的盟友恢复20%韧性。

Purloin Providence.desc: Killing Enemies Marked by Disrupt Destiny have a 100% chance to instantly Quell 5% of your Peril.
Purloin Providence.cn: 击杀被“扰动命运”标记的敌人时，有100%几率立即平息5%危机值。

Furious.desc: For each Enemy you hit during the same Melee Attack, gain +3% Damage on your next Melee Attack.
Furious.cn: 同一次近战攻击每多命中一名敌人，你的下一次近战攻击伤害+3%。

Stay Close!.desc: +20% Toughness Replenishment for you and Allies in Coherency.
Stay Close!.cn: 你和协同范围内的盟友韧性恢复量+20%。

Crunch!.desc: Up to +30% Damage bonus & +30% Impact bonus to your charged Melee Attack, based on charge time.
Crunch!.cn: 根据蓄力时间，你的蓄力近战攻击最多获得+30%伤害和+30%冲击。

Hard Knocks.desc: Enemies staggered by your Melee Attacks take +15% more Melee Damage for 5 s.
Hard Knocks.cn: 被你的近战攻击打至踉跄的敌人，在5秒内额外受到15%近战伤害。

Pacemaker.desc: Hitting 3 or more Enemies with a single Attack grants +15% Reload Speed on your next Reload.
Pacemaker.cn: 单次攻击命中3名或更多敌人后，你的下一次装填速度+15%。

Feel No Pain.desc: You are blessed with 10 Stacks of Feel No Pain. Each Stack grants +3% Toughness Replenishment and +3% Damage Reduction. Taking Damage removes one stack. Stacks are restored every 2 s.
Feel No Pain.cn: 你拥有10层“麻木”。每层提供+3%韧性恢复量和+3%伤害减免。受到伤害会移除1层；每2秒恢复1层。

Delight in Destruction.desc: +5% Damage Resistance per Bleeding Enemy in Melee range. Stacks 6 times.
Delight in Destruction.cn: 近战范围内每有一名正在流血的敌人，获得+5%伤害抗性，最多叠加6层。

Just Getting Started!.desc: While Heavy Hitter is at 8 Stacks, gain +10% Attack Speed.
Just Getting Started!.cn: “重拳出击”达到8层时，攻击速度+10%。

Too Stubborn to Die.cn: 生命值低于50%时，韧性恢复量+100%。

No Stopping Me!.desc: Become Uninterruptible while charging Heavy Melee Attacks. Remove 100% of Heavy Melee Attack Movement Speed penalties.
No Stopping Me!.cn: 蓄力重型近战攻击时不会被打断，并完全移除重型近战攻击的移动速度惩罚。

Massacre.desc: Killing an Enemy grants +2% Critical Chance for 12 s. Stacks 8 times.
Massacre.cn: 击杀敌人后暴击率+2%，持续12秒，最多叠加8层。

Payback Time.desc: +15% Damage for 5 s after a Successful Dodge, or being Hit by an Attack.
Payback Time.cn: 成功闪避或被攻击命中后，伤害+15%，持续5秒。

Unstoppable Momentum.desc: +20% Movement Speed for 3 s on Ranged Kill.
Unstoppable Momentum.cn: 远程击杀后移动速度+20%，持续3秒。

Point-Blank Barrage.desc: Swaps to and reloads your Ranged Weapon. You have +25% Rate of Fire, +65% Reload Speed, 50% Reduced Braced Movement Speed penalties, and gain +15% Close Range Damage for the next 12 s. 50% of Ammo consumed while active is returned to your Reserve once finished. Base Cooldown: 60 s
Point-Blank Barrage.cn: 切换至远程武器并完成装填。接下来12秒内，射速+25%、装填速度+65%，架枪时的移动速度惩罚降低50%，近距离伤害+15%。效果结束时，激活期间消耗弹药的50%会返还至弹药储备。基础冷却时间60秒。

Bullet Bravado.desc: While Point-Blank Barrage is active, Replenish +2.5% Toughness for every shot fired and +15% Toughness on each reload.
Bullet Bravado.cn: “贴身火力”激活期间，每射击一发恢复2.5%韧性，每次装填恢复15%韧性。

No Pain!.desc: Loyal Protector and its Repeats, Replenish 10% Toughness and an additional 0.5% each 1s per enemy affected, up to 10% , for 3 s.
No Pain!.cn: “忠诚护卫”及其重复触发每次恢复10%韧性；每影响一名敌人，之后3秒内每1秒额外恢复0.5%韧性，额外恢复最高10%。

Ruthless Efficiency.desc: You and Allies in Coherency gain additional +12.5% Reload Speed.
Ruthless Efficiency.cn: 你和协同范围内的盟友额外获得+12.5%装填速度。

Remote Detonation.desc: Cause an Explosion at your Cyber-Mastiff's Location. Staggering and Electrocuting nearby Enemies. 2 Charges. 50 s Cooldown.
Remote Detonation.cn: 在你的赛博獒所在位置引发爆炸，使附近敌人踉跄并遭受电击。拥有2次充能，冷却时间50秒。

Force of Will.desc: Replenish 7.5% Toughness on Staggering Melee Attack.
Force of Will.cn: 使敌人踉跄的近战攻击会恢复7.5%韧性。

Walk It Off.desc: Spending 1 Stamina replenishes 10% Toughness over 3 s.
Walk It Off.cn: 消耗1点耐力后，在3秒内恢复10%韧性。

Arbites Vigilant.desc: On Combat Ability, Gain +2.5% Strength for each stack. Lasts 12 s. Removes all Stacks.
Arbites Vigilant.cn: 使用战斗技能时，每层提供+2.5%强度，持续12秒，并移除全部层数。

Razor-Jaw Augment.desc: Enemies knocked away by your Cyber Mastiff's Pounce have 6 Stack(s) of Bleed applied to them.
Razor-Jaw Augment.cn: 被你的赛博獒扑击撞飞的敌人会被施加6层流血。

Justified Measures.desc: +2% Damage on Successful Attack. 5 Max Stacks. Lasts 5 s.
Justified Measures.cn: 成功攻击后伤害+2%，最多叠加5层，持续5秒。

Purgator Servo-Skull.desc: You have an additional Servo-Skull equipped with a Flamer. Target an Area to deploy it. Use your Primary Action to switch between Dispersed or Focused Fire Mode. If Purgator Servo-Skull and Medicae Servo-Skull are both selected, you gain +2 Charges.
Purgator Servo-Skull.cn: 额外装备一颗带火焰喷射器的涤罪伺服头骨。指定区域进行部署；使用主要操作可在分散火力与集中火力模式之间切换。若同时选择“涤罪伺服头骨”和“医疗伺服头骨”，充能次数+2。

Sustained Assault Doctrine.desc: +3% Damage on successful Melee Attack for 8 s. Stacks 5 times.
Sustained Assault Doctrine.cn: 成功的近战攻击使伤害+3%，持续8秒，最多叠加5层。

Vulture's Dodge.desc: Ranged Critical Hits makes you count as Dodging against all Attacks for 1 s.
Vulture's Dodge.cn: 远程暴击后1秒内，你会被视为正在闪避所有攻击。

Adrenaline Smiter.desc: Killing Blows now grants +4 additional stacks of Adrenaline . Elite Killing Blows grants +10 additional stacks. Non-Killing Blows grants none.
Adrenaline Smiter.cn: 造成击杀的攻击现在额外获得4层“肾上腺素”；击杀精英敌人时额外获得10层。未造成击杀的攻击不再获得层数。

Practiced Deployment.desc: Once a Stimm becomes available to use (collected or otherwise), Stimm Supply instantly becomes ready for deployment.
Practiced Deployment.cn: 一旦有兴奋剂可供使用（无论通过拾取或其他方式获得），“兴奋剂补给”会立即准备好部署。

Toxic Renewal.desc: Replenish 1% Toughness every 1 s for each Chem Toxin infected Enemy within 15 m, up to a maximum of 10 Enemies.
Toxic Renewal.cn: 15米内每有一名感染化学毒素的敌人，每1秒恢复1%韧性；最多计算10名敌人。

Fervor.desc: +10% Movement Speed. +10% Dodge Distance. +10% Dodge Speed. +10% Dodge Recovery Speed.
Fervor.cn: 移动速度+10%，闪避距离+10%，闪避速度+10%，闪避恢复速度+10%。

Hypex.desc: While active, Melee Kills grant +75% Ability Cooldown Regeneration for 1 s.
Hypex.cn: 生效期间，近战击杀使技能冷却恢复速度+75%，持续1秒。

Klay.desc: While active, Ranged Kills grant +75% Ability Cooldown Regeneration for 1 s.
Klay.cn: 生效期间，远程击杀使技能冷却恢复速度+75%，持续1秒。

Holy Cause.desc: Channeling 5 pulses grants +40% Toughness Damage Reduction to you and Allies in Coherency. Lasts 10 s.
Holy Cause.cn: 引导5次脉冲后，你和协同范围内的盟友获得+40%韧性伤害减免，持续10秒。

Ecclesiarch's Call.desc: Channeling 5 pulses grants +30% Damage to you and Allies in Coherency. Lasts 10 s.
Ecclesiarch's Call.cn: 引导5次脉冲后，你和协同范围内的盟友获得+30%伤害，持续10秒。

Surety of Arms.desc: 30% Reload Speed while below 75% Peril. On Reload generate up to 15% Peril based on the Percentage of the Clip Restored.
Surety of Arms.cn: 危机值低于75%时，装填速度+30%。装填时，根据恢复的弹匣比例最多生成15%危机值。

Soften Them Up.desc: Enemies damaged by your Melee Attacks take +10% more Damage for 5 s.
Soften Them Up.cn: 被你的近战攻击命中的敌人额外受到10%伤害，持续5秒。

Maximum Firepower.desc: +100% Ability Cooldown Reduction for 4 s when Lucky Bullet triggers.
Maximum Firepower.cn: 触发“幸运子弹”时，技能冷却缩减+100%，持续4秒。

Indomitable.desc: Charge forward with great force, knocking back Enemies and Staggering them. Gain +25% Attack Speed and +25% Movement Speed for 5 s. Charge is stopped on collision with Monstrosities. Base Cooldown: 30 s This is an augmented version of Bull Rush with an increased charge distance of 100% .
Indomitable.cn: 向前强力冲锋，击退并使敌人踉跄。获得+25%攻击速度和+25%移动速度，持续5秒。撞上巨兽时停止冲锋。基础冷却时间30秒。该技能是“蛮牛冲撞”的强化版本，冲锋距离提高100%。

Nuncio-Aquila.desc: Deploy a Nuncio-Aquila in the target direction. Allies within 7.5 m Replenish 7.5% Toughness per second, gain +30% Suppression Dealt, +30% Impact, -25% Recoil as well as are Immune to Stun, Slowdown, and Suppression. Enemies within 7.5 m have +15% Damage Taken. Lasts 20 s. 60 s Cooldown. This is an augmented version of Nuncio-Aquila .
Nuncio-Aquila.cn: 向目标方向部署“天鹰使节”。7.5米内的盟友每秒恢复7.5%韧性，获得+30%压制效果、+30%冲击、-25%后坐力，并免疫眩晕、减速与压制。7.5米内的敌人受到的伤害+15%。持续20秒，冷却60秒。该技能是“天鹰使节”的强化版本。

Target-Neutralization Feedback.desc: Weakspot kills grant Stun and Suppression Immunity for 4 s.
Target-Neutralization Feedback.cn: 弱点击杀会使你免疫眩晕与压制，持续4秒。
